vendor: Siemens SIMATIC WinCC OLE-DB / Connectivity Pack
description: WinCC tags from a site TAG view and archive samples from a site WINCC_ARCHIVE view over the Connectivity Pack TAG:R rowset.
unverified: TAG.TAG_NAME, TAG.COMMENT and TAG.UNIT: WinCC stores external tags in CC_ExternalTag/CC_Tag; these view names need site confirmation.

WINCC_ARCHIVE: the Connectivity Pack returns archive rows only through TAG:R,'tag','start','end', which embeds the tag name in a string literal and cannot be parameterised; a site must create this one-row-per-sample view over TAG:R.
WINCC_ARCHIVE.TIMESTAMP_UTC, VALUE and QUALITY: the archive column names depend on the WinCC project.
LIMIT 1: latest-value queries may need TOP 1 instead on the WinCC provider.
QUALITY: shipped ranges follow OPC quality bit pairs and need confirmation against the project's archive quality codes.

browse.sql: SELECT TAG_NAME, COMMENT, UNIT FROM TAG ORDER BY TAG_NAME

metadata.sql: SELECT COMMENT, UNIT FROM TAG WHERE TAG_NAME = ?

history.sql: SELECT TAG_NAME, TIMESTAMP_UTC, VALUE, QUALITY FROM WINCC_ARCHIVE WHERE TAG_NAME = ? AND TIMESTAMP_UTC >= ? AND TIMESTAMP_UTC <= ? ORDER BY TIMESTAMP_UTC

latest.sql: SELECT TAG_NAME, TIMESTAMP_UTC, VALUE, QUALITY FROM WINCC_ARCHIVE WHERE TAG_NAME = ? ORDER BY TIMESTAMP_UTC DESC LIMIT 1
